name: 3d-pin
blurb: Rotates 3D card inward on hover with title label and animated rings.
description: Wraps children in an anchor; applies 3D perspective transform (rotateX) on hover. Shows title in label and animated background rings. Requires Framer Motion.
use_when: Feature cards, project portfolios, or link cards requiring elevated 3D hover effect.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices; hover effect is mouse-only. Browsers with poor 3D transform support.
a11y: Wraps children in anchor element. Title is visual only; no aria-label for animations or rings.
